firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited a circus starts as the first Seller.
clarifications: With five to eight players, the player seated directly across from the first Seller starts as the second Seller. With four players, there is no second Seller.
Sellers make offers, all bids are simultaneous, and the first Seller resolves their offer first. At the end of a round, Seller tokens pass left.
internalEvidence: Rendered PDF page 2 of Portal Games' publisher-hosted English rulebook and checked page 4 Gameplay. Setup names the latest circus visitor as first Seller, gives the player-count rule for second Seller, and gameplay specifies first-offer resolution and later leftward token passes.
